name: James B. Beam Distilling Co.
hoursNote: Mon 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Tue closed; Wed–Sat 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Sun 9:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. (ET). Closed Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Day, New Year's Day.
blurb: The Jim Beam distillery campus in Clermont, about 30 minutes from Louisville, with guided distillery tours.
sourceNote: Listed by Suntory Global Spirits corporate site
note: Distilling at the main Clermont distillery is paused for 2026; bottling, warehousing and the visitor center stay open. Source: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/jim-beam-to-close-one-of-its-kentucky-distillery-for-a-year-as-the-whiskey-industry-navigates-tariffs (Dec 22, 2025). Not mentioned on the Suntory or Jim Beam sites, which show current hours. Brand sites give the company address as 526 Happy Hollow Rd; the visit page gives 568 for the distillery tour.

name: Maker's Mark Distillery
hoursNote: Open 7 days: Mon–Sat 9:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.–5 p.m. No tours on Easter Sunday, July 4, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve or New Year's Day.
blurb: Distillery tours and seasonal experiences on the Star Hill Farm campus in Loretto.
sourceNote: Listed by Suntory Global Spirits corporate site

name: Buffalo Trace Distillery
hoursNote: Distillery and gift shop: Mon–Sat 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Sun 11:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. (ET). Limited walk-up tour availability daily. Closed Easter Sunday, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Day.
blurb: Sazerac's flagship Kentucky distillery in Frankfort, with daily tours.

name: Woodford Reserve Distillery
hoursNote: Tours and gift shop: Mon–Sat 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun 12–4:30 p.m. (ET). January–February open Thursday–Monday. Tours by reservation; shop and bar open without one.
blurb: A National Historic Landmark distillery in the Bluegrass, about 10 miles from Lexington.
note: Brown-Forman lists it on its Woodford Reserve brand page (https://www.brown-forman.com/brand/woodford-reserve), not on its Where We Operate page.

name: Old Forester Distilling Co.
blurb: Old Forester's distillery on Louisville's Whiskey Row, with tours and George's Bar.
note: Street address from Louisville Tourism because the brand site's address sits behind an age gate. The brand site (https://www.oldforester.com/book-a-tour/) says tours are available at its Main St. Louisville location. Brown-Forman's 322 W. Main St. is where the brand began in 1870, not the visitor address. Hours were not confirmed.

name: Heaven Hill Bourbon Experience
hoursNote: Mon–Sat 9:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Sun 1:00–5:00 p.m. Closed Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Day, New Year's Day.
blurb: Heaven Hill's Bardstown visitor center, with tours, exhibit galleries and the Five Brothers Bar & Kitchen.
sourceNote: Listed by Heaven Hill corporate site
note: Tours of Heaven Hill Springs Distillery (opened September 2025) leave by shuttle from here; visitors have no direct access to that distillery.

name: Evan Williams Bourbon Experience
hoursNote: Mon–Thu 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sun 1–5 p.m. (ET). Last tour one hour before close. Closed New Year's Day, Easter Sunday, Derby Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day.
blurb: A working micro-distillery and visitor experience on Louisville's Whiskey Row.
sourceNote: Listed by Heaven Hill corporate site
